title.narrative: Fiscal Sustainability Support Program
Programa de Apoyo a la Sostenibilidad Fiscal

description.narrative: El objetivo de esta serie programtica y de la primera operacin es fortalecer la sostenibilidad fiscal, por medio del control del gasto y la modernizacin del sistema tributario. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mejorar la efectividad del marco institucional macrofiscal; (ii) aumentar la eficiencia en la gestin del sistema tributario; y (iii) mejorar la eficiencia en la gestin del gasto pblico (empleo, reforma administrativa y pensiones judiciales). La presente operacin corresponde a la primera de dos operaciones bajo la modalidad de Prstamo Programtico de Apoyo a Reformas de Poltica (PBP), a conformarse de dos prstamos contractualmente independientes y tcnicamente vinculados.

The objective of this programmatic series and the first operation is to strengthen fiscal sustainability by controlling expenditure and modernizing the tax system. The specific objectives are to: (i) improve the effectiveness of the macrofiscal institutional framework; (ii) increase the efficiency of tax system management; and (iii) improve efficiency in public expenditure management (employment, administrative reform, and judicial pensions). This is the first of two operations under the programmatic policy-based loan modality, to consist of two contractually independent and technically linked loans.
Commitment in 2019-07-02
Disbursement in fourth quarter of 2019
